author: liyan <yan.l@pku.edu.cn>

metrics.llm_pd_request_input_tokens: D terminal actual original unpadded prompt token count; once per scheduler Req, includes successful/cancelled/failed cohorts separately.
metrics.llm_pd_request_output_tokens: D terminal actual output_ids length clipped at finished_len; includes P handoff token and stop token, excludes MTP tokens after stop. A temporarily popped rebootstrap boundary token is included. Never requested max_new_tokens.
metrics.llm_pd_prefill_stage_input_tokens: Separate P stage terminal input only; never full-request output and never added to D counts.

labels.dp_rank_meaning: global D consumption rank on full-request histograms; global P rank on P stage histogram
labels.prefill_dp_rank_meaning: first actual receiver init rank; fallback req.disagg_prefill_dp_rank; unknown if unresolved; no guessed zero

quantiles.algorithm: histogram_quantile(q, sum(rate(bucket)) by (le, cluster, model_name, optional_domain)); never average rank quantiles
quantiles.coverage: global and P/D grouped terminal distributions require full fresh D service coverage; failures/unknown D identity suppress complete totals

cardinality.note: 31 input and30 output finite buckets; +Inf/sum/count each; five P labels inclunknown x3statuses. All within tested2MiB/node publicationlimit.

collector.container_binding: Exact one-to-four allowlisted names. Proposed new names glm53-flagos-express-1028-4p2d-{p0,p1,p2,p3,d0,d1}; reconcile static JSON with final launcher before rollout.
collector.configuration_policy: Explicit runtime --config supports both topologies; no machine/IP bindings embedded in image code.

integration_steps: Apply SG source patch on the parent SG branch; git apply --check first. It changes only adapter and two rank observation hooks.
Apply assets patch (new tracked directory) or remap its prefix consistently. Preserve adapter byte identity in native asset and python module.
Run scripts/run_cpu_tests.py with promql-parser available (optional --parser-path) and a delegated --output directory; only CPU30/31 and local fake sockets.
Parent commits all reviewed code with author liyan <yan.l@pku.edu.cn>, then pushes the SG branch. Do not use uncommitted files as image source.

Run scripts/package_image_payload.py --sg-repo SG_REPO --commit INTEGRATED_SHA --output NEW_CONTEXT_DIRECTORY. It uses git show of explicit paths and records adapter_commit, monitoring_assets_commit, SHA256.

Build from privacy-audited7de5 base; COPY only generic monitoring adapter/exporter and exact source hook patches. Deployment addresses/native-env/topology/Prom configs are runtime mounts and excluded from image.
Parent records role source commit/SHA plus adapter metadata in image package version, builds/pushes image, then deploys new six-node service. Preserve old containers and monitoring endpoints.

Apply config/native-env per node, explicit allowlisted collector config and combined Prometheus/Grafana files during parent-owned monitoring rollout. Old services show NA for new histograms until separately upgraded.
limits: Terminal observations cannot recover requests lost in a hard process crash or rejected before reaching D scheduler; no inference from requested lengths.
D cancel/error output is actual generated partial length, not guaranteed delivered-to-client length.
Exactly-once scope is one logical scheduler Req, including overlap/retraction callbacks; separate external retries are separate admitted requests.
Metrics path is validated with CPU fixtures and exact witnessed source; new 4p2d inference and live scrape are intentionally not exercised.
No model/device imports, per-token hooks, device synchronization, new RPC or rank labels from request IDs.
